title: Lower spend can hide higher unit cost
method: Synthetic monthly windows: $12,000/600,000 completed jobs=$0.02; $10,000/400,000=$0.025. Unit cost rises 25% although spend falls. Same allocation basis and currency; workload complexity is assumed comparable and must be checked in real data.
alt: Lower spend can hide higher unit cost. Baseline: 0.02 USD/job; Follow-up: 0.025 USD/job. Illustrative values.
